name: muse-code-desktop
description: Unofficial desktop command center for Muse Code

scripts.dev: npm run build:bridge && npm run tauri -w muse-code-desktop -- dev
scripts.build: npm run build:bridge && npm run tauri -w muse-code-desktop -- build
scripts.preview: npm run build:ui && npm run preview -w muse-code-desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @muse/bridge && npm run typecheck -w muse-code-desktop
scripts.verify: npm run check:versions && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:ui && npm run check:a11y && npm run check:contrast && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run build:bridge && npm run build:ui && node scripts/check-chunks.mjs && npm run build:website && npm run test:native
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['apps/desktop/dist','apps/website/dist','packages/muse-bridge/dist']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
